system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: The architect net- work ensures the iterative refinement of the initial generic prompt based on feedback obtained by the oracle.
system_prompt_style.note: The sentinel prompt is rewritten by the architect model. The architect itself uses the fixed INSTRUCTION_TEMPLATE with {context_block}. Paper only, no repo. The second paper in the bundle (Agent*, openreview) is a different system and was ignored.

env_context_strategy.note: Paper only. No config surface is available. The paper describes a document-information service, but no injection mechanism for it.

context_compaction.note: Paper only. No history-processing code is available.

observation_format.evidence_quote: One line containing only the selected tags, separated by a comma and a sin- gle space
observation_format.note: The paper only describes text feedback: prompt-score tuples.

tool_call_format.note: Paper only. No parser code is available.

tool_count.note: The paper mentions one document-information service but gives no tool registry: 'Use of tools by Agent0 is limited to a service that provides document-related information'.

edit_primitive.note: Paper only. No tool definitions are available.

protocol_standardization.note: No source or dependency file is available to grep.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: A consortium of two LLMs and an AutoML component form a feedback loop.
loop_primitives.note: Prompt generation, then oracle evaluation, then refinement. The multi-agent deployment is described as 'a form of a beam search with occasional synchronization steps' (Sec. 6).

planning_granularity.note: Paper only. No planning mechanism is described.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Agent0 at its core consists of two LLMs that are in constant interaction
multi_agent_topology.note: Architect -> Sentinel -> Oracle hand-off. The multi-agent variant runs parallel instances that share memory (Sec. 4).

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: enabling agents to asyn- chronously contribute to a joint memory
delegation_mechanism.note: The shared memory store is the closest fit to a message bus.

human_in_loop.note: The paper mentions a monitoring UI for a supervisor, but no gating.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: stored in a joint memory store of prompt-score tuples
long_term_memory.note: The top 5 best and worst prompts are re-injected as feedback.

self_verification.evidence_quote: a component which estimates the relevance of the feature when included into an existing downstream model
self_verification.note: The AutoML oracle evaluation is the closest value.

retry_policy.note: Sec. 6 says the system 'operates in an infinite loop', but no retry policy is specified.

termination_condition.note: Paper says 'multi-agent system operates in an infinite loop'. No termination condition is given.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Dedicated caching mechanism was put in place to avoid sending unnecessary requests
cost_controls.note: Sentinel request caching. Using o3 for the architect and Gemini-Flash for the sentinel is a fixed role assignment, not routing.

network_policy.evidence_quote: Agent0’s implementation intentionally restricts network access to a minimum (internal proxy to larger LLMs)

tracing.evidence_quote: we implemented a web application that tracks, in real time, the state of prompt-score tuples

eval_hooks.note: No repo is available. The internal AutoML oracle is not a benchmark hook.

target_domain.evidence_quote: one of the first agentic systems geared towards the data science of recommender systems
target_domain.note: Feature discovery for recommender systems; 'other' is also plausible.

open_source.note: No repo URL is given, and the system uses internal Teads services.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: expansion to heterogeneous agent systems, where diverse LLM types contribute to a unified memory store
model_agnostic.note: The paper uses o3 (OpenAI) and Gemini-Flash (Google).

first_release_date.note: Basis: paper v1 date, because no repo is available.

pinned_version.note: No repo is available; pinned to paper v1.
